attributes.indexContent:
* text=auto eol=lf
*.png filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text
*.mp4 binary
*.ttf binary
*.jpg filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text

# Preserve upstream release bytes and unified-diff context for vendor verification.
src-tauri/vendor/glib/** -text -whitespace
src-tauri/vendor/*.patch -text -whitespace

# Keep all recorded evidence byte-for-byte, including BOM/CRLF fixtures.
docs/test-results/** -text -whitespace

lfs.method: Resolve staged LFS pointer against its local LFS object; verify pointer SHA256 and size, then compare original inventory with actual payload bytes. Raw pointer bytes are not mistaken for evidence payload.

limits: Audits only the seven newly retained feature-evidence trees and staged .gitattributes, not all release source/version files.
Inventory entries referring to compressed logs are verified against stored gzip SHA and decompressed original SHA when recorded.
Files outside inventory coverage are checked for exact staged payload equality to the frozen working evidence, and tree completeness.
No repository or index writes; only this /tmp report and its /tmp script are written.
